messages:
elaine_csm: FYI — we're seeing a persistent 503 on embeddings endpoint starting ~14:12 UTC. Impacting ~18 active customers (mostly trials) and 3 mid-market accounts with onboarding jobs failing. Need a short customer status pulse and next-steps comms.

raj_oncall: I saw the alert. Investigating — looks like KV cache miss + a mem leak on one replica. Rolling restart of the node group now. ETA 10-12min for initial mitigation.

aaron_eng: rolling restart in progress. Patch to reduce cache pressure is ready; can push after restarts finish. Fallback to smaller batch size enabled for affected pool (should reduce errors but increase cost).

maria_account_mgr: Can we get a quick list of the 3 renewal-risk accounts? I want to DM them ASAP and offer a workaround. Also need a suggested customer message (short) I can use.

elaine_csm: @maria_account_mgr — impacted accounts: big-press, edu-lex, shopperhq. I'll draft a short one below for CS + AM usage.

elaine_csm: Draft status (copy/paste to customers):

```
Hi <Account Team>,\n\nWe wanted to let you know we're currently investigating intermittent 503 errors affecting the embeddings API since 14:12 UTC. Our engineers are performing a rolling restart and we've enabled a temporary fallback to reduce errors for impacted requests.\n\nWhat this means for you: some embedding jobs may fail or retry; for critical onboarding batches we can run an assisted re-run on Dedicated capacity. We're prioritizing the three accounts most likely to be affected.\n\nNext steps: we'll follow up with another status update within 30 minutes and a full RCA within 48 hours. If you'd like immediate assistance, reply to this thread and your CSM will coordinate a remedial run.\n\nApologies for the disruption — we're on it.\n
Best,\nThe Redwood Inference Team
```

jess_sales_engineer: Can we include an option to temporarily switch those customers to a lower-latency model variant if they want to keep onboarding moving? Might be a good tradeoff for trials.

aaron_eng: That's feasible for shopperhq and big-press (models are compatible). Switching instructions: set model=redwood-compat-small + batch_size=1. I'll prepare an ops snippet if we decide to offer it.

maria_account_mgr: Perfect — I'll DM each AM now with the draft + option to switch models and an offer for a free assisted run.

raj_oncall: Rolling restart finished on 3/4 nodes; error rate has dropped ~80% but not to baseline. Pushing patch in 5. Will monitor for the next 15m, if stable I'll mark incident as "mitigated" and we can send a short update to all impacted.

ops_bot: [alert] embeddings-service: error-rate decreased from 23% -> 4% after restart (anomaly resolved flag pending).

elaine_csm: Ok — plan: 1) AMs reach out to top 3 with the draft + switch option; 2) send a public impacted-customer notice to all 18 (short status note); 3) schedule RCA timeline: 48h for initial RCA + remediation plan. Who can approve the public note?

aaron_eng: I approve the technical wording. Add "temporary fallback enabled" line and note the 48h RCA timeline.

jess_sales_engineer: I approve from GTM side. Recommend offering a single on-demand assisted run + 10% account credit for the three mid-market accounts as goodwill.

maria_account_mgr: Approve. I'll coordinate credits with finance after comms go out.

elaine_csm: I'll send the public update in 10m and PM AMs now. Will capture follow-ups for the RCA doc. Thanks team :handshake:
